cd /tmp && cat > check.mjs <<'EOF'
const B = 'http://localhost:3123'
const title = (h) => (h.match(/<title>([^<]*)<\/title>/) || [,'(none)'])[1]
const has = (h, s) => h.includes(s)

async function page(path) {
  const r = await fetch(B + path, { headers: { 'user-agent': 'check-script/1.0' } })
  const h = await r.text()
  return { status: r.status, title: title(h), html: h }
}

let p = await page('/')
console.log('GET /', p.status, '| title:', p.title,
  '| ua:', has(p.html, 'check-script/1.0'),
  '| ssr-ts:', has(p.html, 'Server-side rendered at:'),
  '| og:', has(p.html, 'og:title'),
  '| font:', has(p.html, 'font') && /\.woff2/.test(p.html),
  '| header/footer:', has(p.html, 'My Blog') && has(p.html, '2024 My Blog'))

p = await page('/blog')
console.log('GET /blog', p.status, '| title:', p.title, '| grid:', has(p.html, 'posts-grid'), '| desc:', has(p.html, 'All blog posts'))

p = await page('/blog/1')
console.log('GET /blog/1', p.status, '| title:', p.title, '| comments:', has(p.html, 'Comments ('), '| back:', has(p.html, 'Back'))

p = await page('/blog/42')
console.log('GET /blog/42 (on-demand, not in generateStaticParams)', p.status, '| title:', p.title)

p = await page('/blog/9999')
console.log('GET /blog/9999 (missing -> notFound)', p.status, '| title:', p.title, '| 404ui:', has(p.html, '404 - Page Not Found'), '| noindex:', has(p.html, 'noindex'))

p = await page('/does-not-exist')
console.log('GET /does-not-exist', p.status, '| title:', p.title, '| 404ui:', has(p.html, '404 - Page Not Found'))
EOF
node check.mjs

cd /tmp && cat > api.mjs <<'EOF'
const B = 'http://localhost:3123/api/posts'
async function call(method, path, body) {
  const r = await fetch(B + path, {
    method,
    ...(body !== undefined ? { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
  })
  const text = await r.text()
  console.log(method, '/api/posts' + path, '->', r.status,
    r.status === 405 ? '| Allow: ' + r.headers.get('allow') : '', '|', text.slice(0, 120))
}
await call('GET', '')
await call('POST', '', { title: 'T', content: 'C' })
await call('POST', '', { title: 'T' })
await call('PATCH', '')
await call('GET', '/7')
await call('PUT', '/7', { title: 'Updated' })
await call('PUT', '/7')
await call('DELETE', '/7')
await call('POST', '/7', {})
EOF
node api.mjs
